description: Composed Stack: submete attestation compressed atomicamente — Shadow Drive upload (immutable) + SP1 verify CPI + Light Protocol leaf insert + Squads vault authority gating. ~$0.03/op vs $0.34 LOCKED rent do flow regular. Requer SP1 proof v6 (356 bytes), public_inputs (96 bytes), payload arbitrário (uploaded a Shadow Drive). Authority é Squads vault[3] Compliance Authority PDA (pode revocar via revoke_composed_attestation).

authorityPubkey.description: Squads vault[3] Compliance Authority PDA (pode revocar). Lookup em scripts/squads-config.json.

commitmentHex.description: 32-byte ZK commitment hex (deve bater com publicInputs[32..64]).

expiresAt.description: Unix timestamp expiração; omitir = no expiry (i64::MAX).

payloadBase64.description: Payload completo (DPIA PDF, evidence JSON, etc.) em base64. Será uploaded a Shadow Drive imutável.

payloadFilename.description: Filename pro Shadow Drive (deve incluir extensão, ex: dpia-q2-2026.pdf).

shdwStorageAccount.description: Shadow Drive storage account pubkey (alocado via scripts/init-shdw-storage-account.ts).

stateQueuePubkey.description: Light Protocol State Queue pubkey paired with stateTreePubkey.

stateTreePubkey.description: Light Protocol State Tree pubkey (alocada via scripts/init-cmt.ts; lookup em scripts/cmt-config.json).

subject.description: Subject pubkey base58 (a quem a attestation se refere).

name: submit_composed_attestation
